Straight-on close-up photograph of a freshly excavated vertical wall next to a real sidewalk. At the top are rows of rectangular concrete paving blocks, directly below is a thin layer of tan sand and dense gray angular gravel, below is compact dark brown natural soil. A short gray drainage pipe emerges from the soil with a clearly hollow round mouth facing the camera. A small dark cavity in the soil beside the pipe. Real full scale excavation in daylight. Soil wall extends to all edges of image; no pedestal, no product display, no floor.
